title: Growing anew while releasing the past
meaning: Your union can create a continuation in new circumstances while still needing time to bring an earlier phase to an emotional close.
text: Creation and saying goodbye to the familiar may sit beside each other in your union’s overall atmosphere. In the physical position, the Empress encourages you to support growth, arrange things and develop what is available now. In energy, the Wheel of Fortune directs effort through changing circumstances: a turn asks for another way to participate. In emotions, Death describes the experience of ending. Even a welcome new possibility does not always remove sadness for an earlier rhythm immediately. Shared life already has a continuation, while feelings still need time to recognise the changed form and release what has finished.

For example, you choose a different place for a summer break. The new surroundings gradually become familiar: you find a favourite route, a convenient café and a pleasant time for walks. Yet some evenings still bring longing for the old place. **Pleasure in something new can live beside sadness for what remains behind.** You need not choose one correct feeling or prove that the change has entirely justified itself before creating good days together. Both responses can belong to the same experience.

The difficulty begins if creative activity is used to close down the sense of loss. You must immediately find more entertainment, improve every arrangement and fill spare hours. Trying to help each other settle, you leave sadness nowhere to go. Every new result receives the impossible task of cancelling the past. Continuation becomes easier when memory can retain its value while shared life grows.
